fundamental.headline: Solid business, cheap vs its history

deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about -5% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.8% = 10-year Treasury 4.8% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 12% last year; 11%/yr over 3 years — the market expects a slowdown from its recent pace.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 67% (3 years ago 42%, rising) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $67 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 62% (3 years ago 32%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $22.2B, up 8% from a year ago — about 0.9× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $7.2B, up 10% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 11%/yr over 3 years and 11%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 36% vs a 5-year range of 30–37% (median 36%): near the top of a fairly narrow range.
deeper.margin_position: near the top of a fairly narrow range

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $9.3B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($9.3B buybacks + $0M dividends) = 10.0% of the company's market value. Share count down 6.7% from a year ago (buybacks outpacing stock pay).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $27.41, up 0% in 90 days; 1 analyst raised, 3 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $24.48, up 1% in 90 days; 0 analysts raised, 3 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By product, latest quarter vs a year earlier: Subscription 97% of sales, up 14%; Services and other 2% of sales, down 14%; Product 1% of sales, down 1%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +15% vs a year ago · $18.42 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 15%, in step with sales (13%): growth comes from more business, not cost cuts.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 8 quarters running by about 2%, yet the stock fell after 6 of them: beats are already expected.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.read: Sales up 13% from a year ago, about as fast as two quarters ago (12%): steady demand.
tiles.explain: Growth of quarterly sales (revenue) compared with the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $36 of operating profit, about the same as a year ago.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 145% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 13× last year's profit (its lowest in 5 years); only 9× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Dec 9; analysts expect EPS of $6.33, up 15% from a year ago. It usually moves about 6% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.

tiles.title: Forecast changes
tiles.read: Next year's EPS forecast is up 0% in 90 days (1 raised, 3 cut lately): forecasts are steady.
tiles.explain: How the average analyst forecast for next year's earnings per share changed (Yahoo, unofficial).
